```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

input_path <- normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), mustWork = TRUE)
data_dir <- dirname(input_path)
repository_root <- normalizePath(file.path(data_dir, "..", ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
assets_dir <- file.path(repository_root, "assets")
widgets_dir <- file.path(assets_dir, "widgets")
includes_dir <- file.path(repository_root, "_includes")

dir.create(widgets_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r import-data}
cv <- readxl::read_xlsx(file.path(data_dir, "presentation tracking spreadsheet.xlsx"),
                        sheet = "data")

required_columns <- c("Year", "Month", "Name", "Type", "Category", "Face")
missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(cv))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop("The data sheet is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

engagement_data <- cv |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    month_number = match(Month, month.name),
    date = lubridate::make_date(year = Year, month = month_number, day = 1),
    Name = gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", trimws(Name)),
    Type = tools::toTitleCase(tolower(trimws(Type))),
    Category = tools::toTitleCase(tolower(trimws(Category))),
    Face = trimws(Face)
  )

invalid_months <- unique(engagement_data$Month[
  !is.na(engagement_data$Month) & is.na(engagement_data$month_number)
])
if (length(invalid_months) > 0) {
  stop("The data sheet contains invalid English month names: ", paste(invalid_months, collapse = ", "))
}
```

```{r build-headline-stats}
dated_engagements <- engagement_data |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(date))

year_min <- min(engagement_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
current_year <- as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
year_max <- max(current_year, engagement_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
category_totals <- engagement_data |>
  dplyr::count(Category, sort = TRUE, name = "engagements")

headline_stats <- data.frame(
  label = c("Presentations", "Keynotes", "Media appearances", "Years speaking"),
  value = c(
    sum(engagement_data$Type == "Platform", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(engagement_data$Category == "Conference (Keynote)", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(engagement_data$Type == "Interview", na.rm = TRUE),
    dplyr::n_distinct(engagement_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

if (any(headline_stats$value < 1)) {
  stop(
    "One or more headline engagement metrics are empty: ",
    paste(headline_stats$label[headline_stats$value < 1], collapse = ", ")
  )
}

headline_markup <- htmltools::tags$div(
  class = "ds-stats",
  role = "list",
  `aria-label` = "Speaking and media engagement totals",
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(headline_stats)), function(index) {
    value <- headline_stats$value[[index]]
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "ds-stat",
      role = "listitem",
      htmltools::tags$div(
        class = "ds-num",
        `data-target` = value,
        format(value, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
      ),
      htmltools::tags$div(class = "ds-label", headline_stats$label[[index]])
    )
  })
)

headline_html <- htmltools::renderTags(headline_markup)$html
writeLines(
  c("<!-- Generated by assets/data/data_cv.Rmd; do not edit directly. -->", headline_html),
  file.path(includes_dir, "engagements-headline-stats.html"),
  useBytes = TRUE
)
```

```{r build-plot}
featured_categories <- utils::head(category_totals$Category, 6)
chart_levels <- c(featured_categories, "Other")

quarterly_engagements <- dated_engagements |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    quarter = lubridate::floor_date(date, unit = "quarter"),
    chart_category = ifelse(Category %in% featured_categories, Category, "Other")
  ) |>
  dplyr::count(quarter, chart_category, name = "engagements") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    chart_category = factor(chart_category, levels = chart_levels),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>", format(quarter, "%B %Y"), "</b><br>",
      chart_category, "<br>", engagements,
      ifelse(engagements == 1, " engagement", " engagements")
    )
  )

chart_palette <- stats::setNames(
  c("#0072B2", "#E69F00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7", "#56B4E9", "#D55E00", "#5F6368"),
  chart_levels
)

engagements <- quarterly_engagements |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    ggplot2::aes(x = quarter, y = engagements, fill = chart_category, text = hover_text),
    width = 80,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(
    limits = as.Date(c(paste0(year_min, "-01-01"), paste0(year_max, "-12-31"))),
    date_breaks = "12 months",
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = chart_palette,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Engagements per quarter",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 12)),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#374151"),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 12, 8, 8)
  )

engagements
```

## Plotly

```{r save-interactive-plot}
set.seed(20261101)
engagement_widget <- plotly::ggplotly(
  engagements,
  tooltip = "text",
  height = 500
) |>
  plotly::layout(
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x = 0,
      xanchor = "left",
      y = -0.2,
      yanchor = "top",
      title = list(text = "<b>Filter by category</b>")
    ),
    margin = list(l = 72, r = 24, t = 20, b = 135),
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white", bordercolor = "#CBD5E1", font = list(color = "#111827"))
  ) |>
  plotly::config(
    displaylogo = FALSE,
    responsive = TRUE,
    modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("lasso2d", "select2d", "autoScale2d")
  )

old_plot_data_ids <- names(engagement_widget$x$attrs)
plot_data_ids <- sprintf("engagements-layer-%02d", seq_along(engagement_widget$x$attrs))
current_data_index <- match(engagement_widget$x$cur_data, old_plot_data_ids)
names(engagement_widget$x$attrs) <- plot_data_ids
names(engagement_widget$x$visdat) <- plot_data_ids
engagement_widget$x$cur_data <- plot_data_ids[[current_data_index]]
if (!is.null(engagement_widget$x$layoutAttrs)) {
  names(engagement_widget$x$layoutAttrs) <- plot_data_ids[match(names(engagement_widget$x$layoutAttrs), old_plot_data_ids)]
}

desktop_tick_years <- seq(year_min, year_max)
mobile_tick_years <- unique(c(
  desktop_tick_years[seq_along(desktop_tick_years) %% 2 == 1],
  max(desktop_tick_years)
))
axis_ticks <- list(
  desktop_values = as.numeric(as.Date(sprintf("%d-01-01", desktop_tick_years))),
  desktop_labels = as.character(desktop_tick_years),
  mobile_values = as.numeric(as.Date(sprintf("%d-01-01", mobile_tick_years))),
  mobile_labels = as.character(mobile_tick_years)
)

engagement_widget <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  engagement_widget,
  "function(el, x, ticks) {
    var currentMobile = null;
    function updateLayout() {
      var mobile = el.clientWidth < 520;
      if (mobile === currentMobile) return;
      currentMobile = mobile;
      Plotly.relayout(el, {
        height: mobile ? 620 : 500,
        'xaxis.tickmode': 'array',
        'xaxis.tickvals': mobile ? ticks.mobile_values : ticks.desktop_values,
        'xaxis.ticktext': mobile ? ticks.mobile_labels : ticks.desktop_labels,
        'xaxis.tickangle': 0,
        'xaxis.tickfont.size': mobile ? 10 : 12,
        'legend.orientation': mobile ? 'v' : 'h',
        'legend.x': mobile ? 0.16 : 0,
        'legend.y': mobile ? -0.16 : -0.2,
        'legend.yanchor': 'top',
        'legend.font.size': mobile ? 11 : 12,
        'margin.b': mobile ? 255 : 135,
        'margin.l': mobile ? 58 : 72,
        'margin.r': mobile ? 10 : 24
      });
    }
    updateLayout();
    if (window.ResizeObserver) {
      new ResizeObserver(updateLayout).observe(el);
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateLayout);
    }
  }",
  data = axis_ticks
)

plot_dependencies <- tempfile(".engagements-files-", tmpdir = widgets_dir)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  plotly::as_widget(engagement_widget),
  file.path(widgets_dir, "engagements.html"),
  selfcontained = TRUE,
  libdir = plot_dependencies
)
unlink(plot_dependencies, recursive = TRUE)

engagement_widget
```

# Data table

```{r save-data-table}
set.seed(20261102)
engagement_table <- engagement_data |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Date = ifelse(is.na(date), as.character(Year), format(date, "%Y-%m-%d")),
    Engagement = Name,
    Format = Type,
    Category = Category
  )

date_renderer <- DT::JS(
  "function(data, type) {",
  "  if (type !== 'display' || !data || data.length !== 10) return data;",
  "  var parts = data.split('-');",
  "  var date = new Date(Date.UTC(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, 1));",
  "  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {month: 'short', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC'}).format(date);",
  "}"
)

category_renderer <- DT::JS(
  "function(data, type) {",
  "  if (type !== 'display') return data;",
  "  var badge = document.createElement('span');",
  "  badge.className = 'category-badge category-' + data.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '');",
  "  badge.textContent = data;",
  "  return badge.outerHTML;",
  "}"
)

datatable_widget <- DT::datatable(
  engagement_table,
  class = "display stripe hover compact",
  extensions = c("Responsive", "FixedHeader"),
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(class = "dt-caption", "Speaking engagements and media appearances"),
  options = list(
    responsive = TRUE,
    fixedHeader = TRUE,
    pageLength = 5,
    lengthMenu = list(c(5, 10, 25, 50), c("5", "10", "25", "50")),
    order = list(list(0, "desc")),
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    language = list(
      search = "",
      searchPlaceholder = "Search all engagements…",
      lengthMenu = "Show _MENU_",
      info = "Showing _START_–_END_ of _TOTAL_ engagements",
      infoEmpty = "No engagements found",
      zeroRecords = "No matching engagements"
    ),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(render = date_renderer, targets = 0, width = "13%", responsivePriority = 2),
      list(targets = 1, width = "51%", responsivePriority = 1),
      list(targets = 2, width = "15%", responsivePriority = 4),
      list(render = category_renderer, targets = 3, width = "21%", responsivePriority = 3),
      list(className = "dt-nowrap", targets = c(0, 2, 3))
    )
  ),
  rownames = FALSE
)

table_css <- paste0(
  "html,body{margin:0;background:#fff;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:#1f2937;}",
  ".dataTables_wrapper{padding:4px 6px 18px;font-size:14px;}",
  ".dataTables_filter{float:none!important;text-align:left!important;margin:0 0 16px!important;}",
  ".dataTables_filter label{display:block;font-weight:600;color:#334155;}",
  ".dataTables_filter input{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(100%,420px)!important;margin:6px 0 0!important;padding:10px 12px!important;border:1px solid #94a3b8!important;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;}",
  ".dataTables_filter input:focus,.dataTables_length select:focus,.paginate_button:focus,table.dataTable thead th:focus{outline:3px solid rgba(0,95,142,.25)!important;outline-offset:2px;}",
  "table.dataTable{border:1px solid #dbe3ea!important;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;}",
  "table.dataTable thead th{background:#edf3f7!important;color:#183b56!important;border-bottom:2px solid #b8c8d4!important;font-weight:700;}",
  "table.dataTable tbody td{padding:11px 10px!important;vertical-align:top;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb!important;line-height:1.45;}",
  "table.dataTable tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#f8fafc!important;}",
  "table.dataTable tbody tr:hover{background:#edf6fa!important;}",
  ".category-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;max-width:100%;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:#e2e8f0;color:#334155;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.35;white-space:normal;}",
  ".category-conference{background:#dbeafe;color:#1e3a8a;}",
  ".category-conference-keynote{background:#f3e8ff;color:#6b21a8;}",
  ".category-meeting{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;}",
  ".category-webinar{background:#ccfbf1;color:#115e59;}",
  ".category-outreach{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;}",
  ".category-lecture{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b;}",
  ".dataTables_info,.dataTables_length,.dataTables_paginate{margin-top:14px!important;color:#475569!important;}",
  ".dataTables_paginate .paginate_button.current{border-color:#005f8e!important;background:#005f8e!important;color:#fff!important;}",
  ".dt-nowrap{white-space:nowrap;}",
  ".dt-caption{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important;}",
  "@media(max-width:600px){.dataTables_wrapper{padding:2px 2px 16px;font-size:13px}.dataTables_filter input{width:100%!important}.dataTables_length,.dataTables_info,.dataTables_paginate{float:none!important;text-align:left!important}.dataTables_paginate{padding-top:8px!important}.dt-nowrap{white-space:normal;}}"
)

datatable_widget <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(
  datatable_widget,
  htmltools::tags$style(htmltools::HTML(table_css))
)

table_dependencies <- tempfile(".datatable-files-", tmpdir = widgets_dir)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  datatable_widget,
  file.path(widgets_dir, "datatable.html"),
  selfcontained = TRUE,
  libdir = table_dependencies
)
unlink(table_dependencies, recursive = TRUE)
```
